query: '
SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), f.fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    f.fecha AS fecha_completa,

    CAST(YEAR(f.fecha) AS INT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,

    CAST(MONTH(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
    CHOOSE(
        MONTH(f.fecha),
        'Enero', 'Febrero', 'Marzo', 'Abril',
        'Mayo', 'Junio', 'Julio', 'Agosto',
        'Septiembre', 'Octubre', 'Noviembre', 'Diciembre'
    ) AS mes_nombre,

    CHOOSE(
        MONTH(f.fecha),
        'Ene', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Abr',
        'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Ago',
        'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dic'
    ) AS mes_corto,

    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,

    d.dia_iso AS dia_semana,
    CHOOSE(
        d.dia_iso,
        'Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles',
        'Jueves', 'Viernes', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'
    ) AS dia_nombre,

    CAST(
        CASE WHEN d.dia_iso IN (6, 7)
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS BIT
    ) AS es_fin_de_semana

FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT discharge_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.admissions
    WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT payment_date AS fecha
    FROM silver.billing
    WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS f

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT CAST(
        (DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', f.fecha) % 7) + 1
        AS TINYINT
    ) AS dia_iso
) AS d
',
